items.label: - Upgraded Comfort
items.value: With wider seats and armrests on outdoor chairs, you won't be uncomfortable with cramped seats and narrow armrests anymore. Padded back cushions and seat cushions add extra comfort. The new upgraded balcony furniture will give you more comfort.

items.label: - Sturdy & Durable
items.value: Our 3 pieces outdoor furniture is made of high quality steel frame and PE rattan, durable enough to withstand the test of time. The wider and thicker structure not only increases the stability of the chair, but also increases the load-bearing capacity of the chair.

items.label: - Large Storage Space
items.value: In addition to the traditional chair table top can be placed drinks, fruit plate and other food. We also designed the table with built-in space so that you can store towels, books, and much more.

items.label: - More Thoughtful Design
items.value: The bottom of the chair features plastic feet to prevent the rattan on the bottom from wearing out and causing the rattan to partially come apart. The rattan and glass can be cleaned up with just a towel wipe, making cleanup very easy.

items.label: - Aesthetics and Practicality
items.value: The 3 piece patio furniture set has a very classic look and color that will perfectly decorate your porch, garden poolside balcony. If there are any problems, please let us know.
